Metadata.title: Athar — Digital Passport for Saudi Handmade Products
Metadata.description: Athar issues a blockchain-verified digital passport for authentic Saudi handmade products, connecting artisans, buyers and their stories.

Home.title: A digital passport for every Saudi handmade story
Home.subtitle: Athar links each authentic handmade product to a tamper-proof digital identity — tracing its maker, materials and journey from the artisan's hands to yours.

provenance.title: Verified provenance
provenance.description: Every passport is anchored on-chain, so authenticity can be checked by anyone, anywhere.

artisans.title: Empowered artisans
artisans.description: Makers tell their own story and receive fair recognition for genuine craftsmanship.

heritage.title: Living heritage
heritage.description: Preserve Saudi craft traditions by documenting each piece's materials and techniques.
